name: Blood Warden
effect: Blocks the Exit Gates when you hook a Survivor inside one after they're opened.
description: Death does not end at the gates.

name: Fire Up
effect: Gains Tokens from completed Generators, increasing several action speeds.
description: Determination fuels your resolve.

name: Remember Me
effect: Gains Tokens from losing chase with the Obsession, increasing Exit Gate opening time.
description: You will not be forgotten.

name: Make Your Choice
effect: Exposes a Survivor who rescues a hooked ally from far away.
description: A difficult choice with dire consequences.

name: Surveillance
effect: Reveals the Aura and status of damaged Generators for a duration.
description: Nothing escapes your watchful eye.

name: Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick
effect: Converts four Hooks into Scourge Hooks that reveal their Auras while carrying a Survivor.
description: A trick that keeps your prey in place.

name: Bamboozle
effect: Increases vaulting speed and briefly blocks the Window you just vaulted.
description: A performer's agility.

name: Coulrophobia
effect: Reduces healing speed within your Terror Radius and increases skill check speed.
description: A fear that follows the crowd.

name: Pop Goes the Weasel
effect: After hooking a Survivor, damaging a Generator instantly regresses extra progress.
description: A trick to keep the pressure on.

name: Hex: Haunted Ground
effect: Cleansing one of two Hex Totems exposes all Survivors for a duration.
description: Cursed ground punishes trespassers.

name: Rancor
effect: Reveals all Survivor locations when a Generator is completed and exposes the Obsession at the end.
description: Vengeance follows those who wronged you.

name: Spirit Fury
effect: After breaking several Pallets, your next Pallet stun instantly breaks it instead.
description: Fury builds with every obstacle.

name: Discordance
effect: Reveals the Aura of Generators being repaired by two or more Survivors.
description: You sense cooperation from afar.

name: Iron Maiden
effect: Increases Locker search speed and exposes Survivors exiting Lockers.
description: A trap sprung on the unwary.

name: Mad Grit
effect: Removes the cooldown from missed attacks while carrying a Survivor.
description: Nothing will make you drop your prey.

name: Corrupt Intervention
effect: Blocks the three farthest Generators at the start of the Trial.
description: Corruption spreads from the start.

name: Dark Devotion
effect: Transfers your Terror Radius to the Obsession when they become injured.
description: A dark devotion binds you to your Obsession.

name: Infectious Fright
effect: Causes nearby Survivors to scream and reveal their location when someone enters the Dying State.
description: Fear spreads like a plague.

name: Furtive Chase
effect: Grants Undetectable and Haste after hooking the Obsession.
description: A silent stalker's reward.

name: I'm All Ears
effect: Reveals a Survivor's Aura after they perform a rushed vault nearby.
description: You hear everything.

name: Thrilling Tremors
effect: Blocks all unrepaired Generators for a duration after picking up a Survivor.
description: The ground trembles with anticipation.

name: Cruel Limits
effect: Blocks all Windows for a duration after a Generator is completed.
description: There are limits you enforce cruelly.

name: Mindbreaker
effect: Inflicts Blindness and Exhaustion on Survivors after they stop repairing a Generator.
description: You break their focus.

name: Surge
effect: Downing a Survivor with a basic attack causes nearby Generators to instantly regress.
description: A surge of destructive energy.

name: Blood Echo
effect: Hooking a Survivor inflicts Exhaustion and Haemorrhage on all injured Survivors.
description: Blood calls to blood.

name: Nemesis
effect: Stunning you transfers Obsession status to the stunning Survivor.
description: You become fixated on those who defy you.

name: Zanshin Tactics
effect: Reveals nearby Pallet and Window Auras, plus a Survivor's Aura after they drop a Pallet.
description: A warrior's constant awareness.

name: Dead Man's Switch
effect: Blocks the first Generator a Survivor stops repairing after being hit.
description: A trap sprung when they least expect it.

name: Gearhead
effect: Reveals a Survivor's Aura after they succeed a Skill Check for a duration.
description: You know your way around machinery.

name: Hex: Retribution
effect: Cleansing this Hex inflicts Oblivious, but reveals all Survivor Auras once it's gone.
description: Retribution comes swiftly.

name: Deathbound
effect: Causes a healer to scream and become Oblivious if they stray far from the healed Survivor.
description: Bound by torment.

name: Forced Penance
effect: Inflicts Broken on Survivors who take a Protection Hit for another.
description: Penance for their choices.

name: Trail of Torment
effect: Grants Undetectable after damaging a Generator, while revealing its Aura to Survivors.
description: A trail of suffering follows you.

name: Dragon's Grip
effect: Exposes the first Survivor to interact with a Generator you just damaged.
description: A grip that punishes interference.

name: Hex: Blood Favour
effect: Blocks nearby upright Pallets whenever a Survivor loses a Health State.
description: Blood grants favour to the worthy.

name: Hex: Undying
effect: Reveals Survivors near Dull Totems and transfers this Hex to another Totem when cleansed.
description: A curse that refuses to die.

name: Coup de Grâce
effect: Gains Tokens from completed Generators that extend your lunge range.
description: A finishing blow, perfected.

name: Hoarder
effect: Reveals when Survivors interact with Chests and spawns additional Chests.
description: You covet what others seek.

name: Oppression
effect: Damaging a Generator affects several random Generators, triggering Skill Checks on them.
description: Oppression spreads through the trial.

name: Hex: Crowd Control
effect: Blocks a Window after a rushed vault through it and reveals nearby Survivor Auras.
description: You control the crowd from the stage.

name: No Way Out
effect: Gains Tokens from hooking Survivors that block the Exit Gates once opened.
description: There is no way out of your finale.

name: Starstruck
effect: Exposes Survivors in your Terror Radius after you drop a carried Survivor.
description: They can't help but stare.

name: Eruption
effect: Downing a Survivor causes nearby damaged Generators to regress and reveals Survivor Auras.
description: An eruption of chaos follows every down.

name: Hysteria
effect: Injuring a healthy Survivor causes all injured Survivors to become Oblivious.
description: Panic spreads faster than infection.

name: Lethal Pursuer
effect: Reveals all Survivor Auras at the start of the Trial and extends future Aura reveals.
description: A lethal pursuit begins immediately.

name: Deadlock
effect: Blocks a Generator whenever another Generator is completed.
description: A deadlock none can escape.

name: Hex: Plaything
effect: Curses a hooked Survivor with Oblivious until the Hex Totem is cleansed.
description: You are my plaything now.

name: Scourge Hook: Gift of Pain
effect: Converts Hooks into Scourge Hooks that inflict lingering Haemorrhage on unhook.
description: A gift wrapped in agony.

name: Grim Embrace
effect: Gains Tokens from first hooks that block Generators for increasing durations.
description: A grim embrace tightens with every hook.

name: Nowhere to Hide
effect: Reveals nearby Survivor Auras after damaging a Generator.
description: There is nowhere left to hide.

name: Bitter Murmur
effect: Reveals Survivor Auras near a completed Generator.
description: A bitter murmur travels through the fog.

name: Call of Brine
effect: Increases regression on a damaged Generator and triggers Skill Check notifications.
description: A call that lingers over stagnant water.

name: Merciless Storm
effect: Triggers continuous Skill Checks on a highly progressed Generator, blocking it if failed.
description: A storm without mercy.

name: Scourge Hook: Floods of Rage
effect: Converts Hooks into Scourge Hooks that reveal all Survivor Auras when someone unhooks from them.
description: Rage floods through the fog.

name: Darkness Revealed
effect: Reveals nearby Survivor Auras after searching a Locker.
description: Darkness reveals what light cannot.

name: Dissolution
effect: Instantly breaks the next Pallet vaulted in your Terror Radius after injuring a Survivor.
description: Barriers dissolve before you.

name: Septic Touch
effect: Inflicts Blindness and Exhaustion on Survivors healing within your Terror Radius.
description: A touch that festers.

name: Awakened Awareness
effect: Reveals nearby Survivor Auras while carrying a Survivor.
description: An awareness that never sleeps.

name: Superior Anatomy
effect: Grants a burst of vaulting speed after a Survivor rush-vaults nearby.
description: A superior form, a superior hunter.

name: Terminus
effect: Inflicts Broken on injured, dying, or hooked Survivors once the Exit Gates are powered.
description: This is the terminus.

name: Hubris
effect: Exposes a Survivor who stuns you.
description: Their hubris will be their downfall.

name: Human Greed
effect: Reveals unopened Chest Auras and Survivor Auras near Chests you kick.
description: Greed reveals itself in the fog.

name: Game Afoot
effect: Transfers Obsession status to the Survivor with the highest chase time when hit, granting Haste.
description: The game is afoot.

name: Leverage
effect: Reduces healing speed for a Survivor after they are unhooked.
description: Every advantage counts.

name: THWACK!
effect: Breaking obstacles using Tokens causes nearby Survivors to scream and reveal their Auras.
description: THWACK! goes the obstacle.

name: Forced Hesitation
effect: Inflicts Hindered on nearby Survivors after injuring one.
description: Hesitation is forced upon them.

name: Genetic Limits
effect: Inflicts Exhaustion on a Survivor who loses a Health State.
description: There are limits to their genetics.

name: Machine Learning
effect: Grants Undetectable and Haste for a duration after damaging a Generator.
description: The machine learns from every action.

name: Alien Instinct
effect: Reveals the farthest injured Survivor's Aura after hooking someone.
description: An instinct as old as the species.

name: Rapid Brutality
effect: Grants Haste after a basic attack hit, forfeiting Bloodlust.
description: Brutality without hesitation.

name: Ultimate Weapon
effect: Causes nearby Survivors to scream and suffer Blindness after searching a Locker.
description: The ultimate weapon strikes fear.

name: Batteries Included
effect: Grants Haste near completed Generators.
description: Batteries included, fun guaranteed.

name: Friends 'til the End
effect: Reveals the Obsession's Aura and exposes them after hooking a non-Obsession Survivor.
description: Friends 'til the end.

name: Hex: Two Can Play
effect: After several blinds or stuns, ignites a Hex Totem that blinds those who blind or stun you.
description: Two can play at this game.

name: Unbound
effect: Grants Haste after a Survivor performs a window vault following an injury.
description: Unbound by the rules of reality.

name: Undone
effect: Gains Tokens from failed Skill Checks to regress a Generator when damaged.
description: What was done can be undone.

name: Unforeseen
effect: Transfers your Terror Radius to a damaged Generator and grants Undetectable.
description: An unforeseen shift in perception.

name: Dark Arrogance
effect: Increases vaulting speed and reduces Pallet stun recovery time.
description: Arrogance born from dark power.

name: Languid Touch
effect: Inflicts Exhaustion on a Survivor who startles a Crow nearby.
description: A touch that saps their will.

name: Weave Attunement
effect: Reveals Item and Survivor Auras after an Item depletes, inflicting Oblivious on the holder.
description: Attuned to the weave of fate.

name: Dominance
effect: Blocks the first Chest or Totem a Survivor interacts with.
description: Dominance over all who oppose you.

name: Hex: Wretched Fate
effect: Curses the Obsession with reduced repair speed and a visible Aura when a Generator completes.
description: A wretched fate awaits.

name: All-Shaking Thunder
effect: Increases lunge range for a duration after falling from a height.
description: Thunder that shakes the ground.

name: No Quarter
effect: Triggers continuous Skill Checks during self-healing, inflicting Broken on failure.
description: No quarter given.

name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass
effect: Converts Hooks into Scourge Hooks that reveal the most progressed Generator's Aura on hook.
description: A compass that always points to progress.

name: Forever Entwined
effect: Gains Tokens from damaging Survivors, increasing dropping and hooking speed.
description: Forever entwined in suffering.

name: None Are Free
effect: Gains Tokens from first hooks that block Windows and Pallets when a Generator completes.
description: None are free until all are caught.

name: Hex: Nothing but Misery
effect: After several basic attacks, ignites a Hex Totem that inflicts Hindered on hit.
description: Nothing but misery remains.

name: Haywire
effect: Causes an Exit Gate to regress if a Survivor stops opening it partway through.
description: Something's gone haywire.

name: Help Wanted
effect: Grants Undetectable and increased recovery speed after damaging a Generator.
description: Help wanted, applications welcome.

name: Phantom Fear
effect: Causes a Survivor who looks at you in your Terror Radius to scream and reveal their Aura.
description: A phantom fear grips them.

name: Hex: Overture of Doom
effect: Transfers your Terror Radius to the farthest Generator once it's repaired, granting Undetectable.
description: An overture that heralds doom.

name: Ravenous
effect: Gains Tokens from first hooks that expose Survivors once maxed.
description: A ravenous hunger for the hunt.

name: Wandering Eye
effect: Reveals nearby injured Survivor Auras when starting a chase.
description: A wandering eye that misses nothing.

name: Secret Project
effect: Blesses or cleanses a Totem to block a random Generator and grant Undetectable.
description: A secret project comes to fruition.

name: Turn Back the Clock
effect: After hooking a Survivor, causes a nearby Generator to explode and regress.
description: Time can be turned back.

name: Hex: Scared to Death
effect: After hooking several Survivors, breaking a Pallet causes nearby Survivors to scream and become Hindered.
description: Scared to death, and rightly so.

name: Rampage
effect: Gains Tokens from breaking obstacles that grant Haste after being stunned.
description: A rampage none can stop.

name: Silent Shadow
effect: Grants Undetectable after hooking a Survivor, extended for the rest of the Trial once gates are powered.
description: A silent shadow in the dark.

name: Celestial Witness
effect: Periodically reveals the Obsession's Aura if they are far from you.
description: A celestial witness to their fate.

name: Hex: Under Your Thumb
effect: Limits running Survivors' Haste gains and reveals their location when they exceed it.
description: Kept firmly under your thumb.

name: Lay Waste
effect: Damaging a Generator increases its regression based on remaining charges.
description: Lay waste to their progress.

name: Distressing
effect: Increases the size of your Terror Radius.
description: Your presence radiates dread.

name: Insidious
effect: Grants Undetectable after standing still for a few seconds.
description: An insidious patience.

name: Iron Grasp
effect: Reduces wiggle progress gained while carrying a Survivor.
description: An iron grip none can escape.

name: Sloppy Butcher
effect: Basic attacks inflict Haemorrhage and Mangled, increasing blood pool spawn and healing regression.
description: A sloppy but effective technique.

name: Whispers
effect: Notifies you when a Survivor is within a set range.
description: The Entity whispers of nearby prey.

name: Unrelenting
effect: Reduces the cooldown after a missed basic attack.
description: You do not relent.

name: Deerstalker
effect: Periodically reveals the Aura of the Survivor with the lowest accumulated chase time.
description: A hunter's patient tracking.

name: Spies from the Shadows
effect: Triggers a loud noise notification when a Crow is startled nearby.
description: Spies that watch from the shadows.

name: Hex: Devour Hope
effect: Gains Tokens from distant unhooks that grant Haste, Exposure, and eventually the ability to kill.
description: Hope devoured turns to power.

name: Hex: Face the Darkness
effect: Curses an injured Survivor to periodically cause nearby Survivors to scream.
description: Face the darkness within.

name: Hex: Fortune's Fool
effect: Curses the first hooked Survivor with Oblivious while the Hex Totem remains lit.
description: Fortune favours no fool.

name: Hex: Hive Mind
effect: Highlights Generator repair progress and causes fully repaired Generators to regress on explosion.
description: A hive mind connects every machine.

name: Hex: Pentimento
effect: Allows resurrecting cleansed Totems as cursed ones that reduce nearby action speeds.
description: What was painted over returns.

name: Hex: Thrill of the Hunt
effect: Increases Totem cleansing and blessing time based on remaining Tokens.
description: The thrill of a hunt well fought.

name: Keep Them Waiting
effect: Gains Tokens from non-Obsession attacks that reduce your attack cooldown.
description: Keep them waiting in fear.

name: No Holds Barred
effect: Blocks the most progressed Generator whenever another Generator is completed.
description: No holds barred in this hunt.

name: Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine
effect: Converts Basement Hooks into Scourge Hooks that speed up the Sacrifice Process for distant Survivors.
description: A monstrous shrine below.

name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
effect: Converts Hooks into Scourge Hooks that cause a damaged Generator to regress on first hook.
description: Pain resonates through the fog.

name: Scourge Hook: Weeping Wounds
effect: Converts Hooks into Scourge Hooks that inflict lingering Haemorrhage on unhook.
description: Wounds that weep long after.

name: See How They Run
effect: Gains Tokens from losing the Obsession in chase that grant Haste when consumed by an attack.
description: See how they run.

name: Shattered Hope
effect: Reveals Survivor Auras after destroying a Boon Totem.
description: Hope shatters like glass.
